messages:
emma: quick follow-up proposal for a hybrid gating rule: apply profile-level soft-floor, but allow per-layer exceptions for top-k attention layers.

rafael: why only attention layers?

emma: empirical sensitivity shows attention and final MLP layers drive most quality loss when lowered. keeping them higher preserves outputs while lowering other layers saves cost.

priya: runtime complexity? grouping layers into 3 classes (attn/mpf/other) keeps kernel explosion manageable.

rafael: need hysteresis and a batching fallback - if batch hetero > 20% fallback to uniform profile.

bench-bot: queued perf test: hybrid-layer-gate on redwood-13b, sample=2k requests. ETA 18h. :spiral_calendar:
